notes.title: Version update: English version now online
notes.notes:
We appreciate all the waiting, Dong-Jin Rice-hime is now officially available in English, you could change your language setting to 「English」to switch your version

※ Cross saving isn’t available between different versions

A promotional sale is starting now until the sixth of March, we are on history low of 40% off! We hope that you will enjoy the localization and now is your best chance to raise your own Rice-hime!

notes.title: The Japanese version of the store page is available now!
notes.notes:

notes.title: Dong-Jin Rice-hime -Expansion Pack Release!
notes.notes:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28579562/85ccbc0d36c9b5b588b3eafed2a90c1d2904e791.png

Dong-Jin Rice-hime -Expansion Pack Release!

New contents have been added to Rice-hime! In addition to two new varieties of Rice, we have also included Japanese voice acting!

DLC content includes:
● Cultivate two new varieties of Rice
● Four new achievements
● Events now feature our new Japanese dubbing - CV: Ai Kayano
● New Chinese theme song - lead singer: Xin-nan(薛南), composer: 3R2

Not only this, but events have also been added for the special appearance of AIR (艾兒) and MAGI (小瑪).

p.s. English localization is on going, we will update later.
